title: Report Annals model usage
summary: Show recent Annals source deliveries with their attributable model-token use, coverage gaps, and calculable rate-card equivalent.
use_when: Recent Annals source deliveries should be correlated with their observed Nucleus model attempts and token records.
Coverage gaps, exact response totals, cumulative fallbacks, no-model deliveries, or examination reuse must be distinguished.
do_not_use_when: The request concerns all account activity or arbitrary Nucleus requesters rather than Annals attribution.
A hidden subscription denominator, invoice, or reliable per-delivery allowance percentage is expected.
A retained offline report is required.
outcome: A current in-memory projection of recent Annals delivery attempts, token categories, coverage, and calculable rate-card equivalent, qualified by explicit gaps and attribution limits.
effects: Reads Annals delivery records and inbox receipts plus Nucleus job, attempt, and ordered output records.
Calculates the projection in memory and stores no telemetry database, aggregate, or account snapshot.
Makes no model call and changes no Annals or Nucleus domain state.
authority: Nucleus exact output atoms and job state, Annals model-run attribution, delivery records, and job receipts are the durable authorities.
Annals Usage owns only the disposable live interpretation and its projection version.
success: Every reported delivery and attempt carries a coverage value explaining whether its total is exact, cumulative, incomplete, pending, no-model, or reused.
Overlapping token categories are not added twice.
Unattributed runs and output gaps remain visible rather than being silently reassigned or estimated.
failure_and_recovery: If an Annals or Nucleus authority is unavailable, the command fails rather than returning a stale stored projection.
A `gap` result means no authoritative complete delivery total exists; inspect underlying output and attribution rather than inventing one.
Use the Annals retry-event report, not usage projection, to pair original and child delivery outcomes.
privacy: The report reads private Annals attribution and Nucleus output records, though it does not copy them into a new database.
Retain and back up the underlying authorities when historical recalculation must remain possible.
does_not_authorize: Any Annals corpus or inbox mutation.
Any Nucleus job, authentication, or service mutation.
A claim that a rate-card equivalent is an invoice or subscription share.
